Services & Pricing

Production, mixing & mastering

All services are remote. Send your files, get a custom quote based on the song, and receive a record ready to release.

No generative AI — at any part of the music process. Every song is created manually in a DAW, with real instruments and plugins, by CRDN Studios.

01 — REMOTE

Production

From voice memo to full track

Send a voice memo, a piano demo, or a rough idea. It gets built into a full production: arrangement, instrumentation, and sound design that serve the song.

  • Full arrangement & instrumentation
  • Built around your vocal & melody
  • Revisions together until it feels right

02 — REMOTE

Mixing

Clarity, balance, emotion

Your recorded tracks, mixed into one cohesive record. The vocal sits where it belongs, the low end is solid, and every element earns its place — in your headphones, your car, and everywhere else.

  • Vocal-first balance & polish
  • Works from home-studio recordings
  • Mix notes rounds included

Mastering

The final 10% that sounds like 50%

The last step before release. Your mix gets its final polish — loudness, tone, and translation dialed in so it holds up next to the records it's competing with on every platform.

  • Streaming-ready loudness
  • Translates on every system
  • Release-ready files delivered
